harness.note: the real controller machine code over scripted pad input and a scripted clock; UI, sound and pad-read calls replaced by recorders. An independent Python model agreed on every exported vector.

description: Auron's Bushido: the four button sequences and the result for scripted presses (one pad word a frame).
notes: in.cat is the Overdrive family byte (0x22 Shooting Star, 0x32 Dragon Fang, 0x42 Banishing Blade, 0x52 Tornado); in.pal is the PAL tick-rate flag.
in.presses are [controller frame (from 1 in the input state), pad word]; a word is compared as a whole word with the sequence word at the current index.
class sequence holds what the real set-up wrote: the length, the limit B (float32 bits) and the pad words in order.
out.wrong counts the wrong presses (the game plays a sound and sets the index back to 0); out.indexTrace (where present) is the sequence index after each frame.
class gap presses the whole sequence with that many frames between inputs; class last finishes it in a given frame; class random mixes right and wrong words.
name: minigame_bushido
